question.prompt: A can of soup can feed \(3\) adults or \(5\) children. If there are \(5\) cans of soup and \(15\) children are fed, then how many adults would the remaining soup feed?

solutions.explanation:
First find how many cans the children use. Since each can feeds \(5\) children, feeding \(15\) children requires
\[15\div5=3\text{ cans}.\]
That leaves \(5-3=2\) cans. Each remaining can feeds \(3\) adults, so the soup can feed \(2\cdot3=6\) adults, choice \(\mathrm B\).
solutions.title: Find the remaining cans
